mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5pp), or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL monthly change and 20-day returns is above -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets drive wage growth and corporate profit expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeding 2.0% signals strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and high interest rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) regimes, the market anticipates prolonged monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rate regime
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC between the regime condition and 60-day returns is above -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and decreases in employment (PAYEMS) indicate a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of periods where UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases month-over-month, or the interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
